meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把任意文章或笔记快速变成一个视觉讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手头有文字资料想做成视频,又不想真人出镜或录屏
copy.tagline_en: Create a visual explainer video from any text
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to repurpose written content into video without filming or screen capture

howto.what: 把用户提供的任意文字（文章、笔记、主题或简报）转成“无脸讲解视频”：没有网站或实拍素材，每个场景的视觉（字体排版、抽象图形、图表、数据可视化）都是按场景从零构想。它按流程工作：选用设计预设、规划教学故事、逐帧生成HTML帧、配上旁白与音乐，最终渲染成MP4。
howto.when: 当用户把一段说明文字（文章、笔记、主题、简报）交给它，要求做主题讲解、概念拆解、如何做等讲解视频时触发。有歧义或不确定时，它会先去看/hyperframes来路由。不做基于网站的推广片。

say.text: 把这篇讲复利的文章做成一段无脸讲解视频。
say.note: 它会走完简报确认、故事板、逐帧生成和渲染流程。

say.text: 用列表式盘点讲讲如何养成阅读习惯，做成视频。
say.note: 内容会被重排成教学顺序，配上旁白和视觉。

say.text: 把这段笔记变成一个1分钟的概念拆解视频。
say.note: 它按简报设定时长并跳过素材采集，直接合成。

howto.what_en: Turns any text into a faceless explainer video: no site or footage, so visuals (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz) are invented per scene. It picks a design preset, plans a teaching story, builds HTML frames, adds narration/music, and renders an MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user gives explanatory text and asks for an explainer video (topic explainer, concept breakdown, how-to, etc.). If uncertain, it defers to /hyperframes for routing. Not for website-based promos.

say_en.text: Turn this article about compound interest into a faceless explainer video.
say_en.note: It runs the full pipeline: brief, storyboard, frames, render.

say_en.text: Make a listicle explainer on how to build a reading habit.
say_en.note: Content is reordered for teaching, with narration and visuals.

say_en.text: Turn these notes into a 1-minute concept breakdown video.
say_en.note: It sets the length from the brief and skips capture entirely.
